description: This file contains a PHP trait named SubunitIdChainTrait that provides functionality to retrieve a chain of subunit IDs within a company structure, leveraging a service for hierarchy retrieval. It is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the PIM (Personal Information Management) module's DTO traits.

methods.name: getSubunitIdChain
methods.description: Retrieves the chain of subunit IDs for the current object, utilizing a service and caching the result.
